description.value: Erbil Restaurant is a Mediterranean and Turkish kebab house on Vancouver's vibrant Commercial Drive, named after the ancient city of Erbil in Iraqi Kurdistan and serving dishes rooted in Kurdistani and Turkish culinary traditions. The menu spans grilled skewer kebabs, shawarma, dolma, slow-cooked lamb shank, oven-grilled fish, pide, and an elaborate Turkish breakfast spread. A touring cyclist will find generous, hearty plates and a 24-hour operation that keeps the kitchen open regardless of arrival time.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at erbilrestaurant.ca fully corroborates the OSM address (1861 Commercial Dr, Vancouver, BC V5N 4A6) and primary phone number (+1 604 558 6515), and shows an active, operating restaurant with a comprehensive menu, online reservation system, and a 'Metrotown Branch Coming Soon' notice confirming the business is live. Vegetarian options (Veggie Plate, Veggie Pide, Falafel Plate) are explicitly listed on the menu, and Uber delivery is promoted on the About page confirming takeout/delivery capability. No bike-specific amenities (rack, Wi-Fi, charging, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website lists a second phone number (+1 778 681 5355) not present in OSM.
Website claims 24-hour operation every day of the week — unusual for a restaurant; may be aspirational or erroneous, but not a closure indicator.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant on Commercial Drive with a confirmed address, active website, and a full menu — clearly a useful refueling stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: A Metrotown branch is advertised as 'Coming Soon' on the homepage; a separate OSM record may eventually be warranted for that location.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Veggie Plate (steamed broccoli, carrots, boiled potatoes, pida), Veggie Pide, Falafel Plate, hummus, and multiple salad/soup options that are vegetarian

wow_evidence: 24-hour operation that keeps the kitchen open regardless of arrival time
